_doc: ORBITAL PROGRAM workstream e-entity (research/orbital_program.md cross-tie (b)): seed mapping of the biggest / most-relevant satellite operators & launch providers to the public company + ticker where one exists, so a company lookup can show its ORBITAL footprint beside its jets / vessels / plants in the Everything Graph (server/entityGraph.ts pattern). RAW reference data, mirroring datacore/entity_map.json's discipline: asserts an operator->company->ticker relationship with provenance, NO predictive claim. HONESTY RULE (hard): a wrong ticker is worse than an honest 'unmapped'. ticker is null wherever the operator is private, governmental, or the mapping is uncertain -- never a guessed symbol. Corporate structures churn (M&A, going-private, spinoffs, ticker changes) so re-verify before any inference is trusted or traded; per research/orbital_program.md the trading signal from constellation-size change is SPECULATIVE and slow -- structural / showcase value is the real justification here.
provenance: All public tickers verified via live WebSearch on 2026-07-07 against company IR pages / SEC filings / exchange listings. Private and governmental owners carry no ticker by construction (nothing to verify). Two stale-symbol corrections caught this build: EchoStar changed its Nasdaq ticker SATS->ECHO effective 2026-06-24 (SATS is now WRONG); Iridium (IRDM) is under an announced ~$8B acquisition by Rocket Lab (RKLB) and could delist if it closes.

operators.notes: Privately held -- NO public equity as of 2026-07-07 (Starlink not separately listed either). Operates the Starlink LEO comms mega-constellation (thousands of sats) plus Falcon/Starship launch. ticker deliberately null; never map the private parent to a proxy. Verified 2026-07-07.

Nasdaq: RKLB (Rocket Lab Corp). Small-lift Electron / Neutron launch + Photon spacecraft bus. WATCH: announced an ~$8B agreement to acquire Iridium (IRDM) -- would fold IRDM assets under RKLB if it closes. Verified 2026-07-07.
Nasdaq: ASTS. Direct-to-cell BlueBird LEO constellation. Verified 2026-07-07.
Nasdaq: VSAT. Acquired Inmarsat (2023) -- Inmarsat-labelled satellites now roll up to VSAT, so Inmarsat operator strings are mapped here. Verified 2026-07-07.

Nasdaq: IRDM. 66-active-sat cross-linked LEO voice/data/IoT constellation. WATCH: under an announced ~$8B acquisition by Rocket Lab (RKLB) as of mid-2026 -- still independently listed on 2026-07-07 but may delist if the deal closes; re-verify. Verified 2026-07-07.

Nasdaq: GSAT (Nasdaq Global Select). Uplisted from NYSE American to Nasdaq on 2025-02-11 alongside a 1-for-15 reverse split -- symbol unchanged (GSAT), exchange changed. LEO voice/IoT; major Apple satellite-connectivity customer. Verified 2026-07-07.

Nasdaq: ECHO. CRITICAL STALE-SYMBOL CORRECTION -- EchoStar changed its Nasdaq ticker from SATS to ECHO effective 2026-06-24; do NOT use SATS. Parent of Hughes (GEO broadband), DISH, Boost Mobile, Sling. Verified 2026-07-07.

Euronext Paris: SESG (Yahoo/quote suffix SESG.PA; also on Luxembourg exchange). GEO fleet + O3b/O3b mPOWER MEO constellation. Agreed to acquire Intelsat (deal announced Apr-2024) -- if closed, Intelsat assets fold under SES. Verified 2026-07-07.
Euronext Paris: ETL (quote suffix ETL.PA). Formed by the 2023 Eutelsat (GEO) + OneWeb (LEO) combination -- OneWeb-labelled sats map here. Verified 2026-07-07.

PRIVATE -- no public equity since emerging from Chapter 11 in 2022 as a privately held company. SES agreed to acquire Intelsat (announced Apr-2024, ~$3.1B); if/when the deal closes the economic parent is SES (Euronext: SESG), but Intelsat itself has no ticker. ticker deliberately null. Verified 2026-07-07.
NYSE: PL. Daily-imaging Dove/SuperDove + SkySat fleet -- the dominant commercial EO smallsat operator. Verified 2026-07-07.

PRIVATE -- taken private by Advent International + BCI, completed 2023-05-03 (~$6.4B); previously NYSE/TSX: MAXR. Its manufacturing arm (Maxar Space Systems) was divested to Intuitive Machines as 'Lanteris Space Systems' in Nov-2025; the high-res WorldView imaging business (Maxar Intelligence) remains privately held. NO public equity -> ticker null. Verified 2026-07-07.
NYSE: SPIR. RF/GNSS-RO smallsat constellation (weather, AIS ship-tracking, ADS-B). Verified 2026-07-07.
NYSE: BKSY. High-revisit Gen-2/Gen-3 EO smallsats + analytics; heavy US-government exposure. Verified 2026-07-07.

NYSE: LMT. Builder/operator of many defense and civil satellites (GPS III, SBIRS, weather, comsats). Attribution is as BUILDER/prime, not necessarily on-orbit owner (many are USSF/NOAA-owned). Verified 2026-07-07.
NYSE: NOC. Defense/space prime (absorbed Orbital ATK 2018); builds military and civil buses, MEV servicing vehicles. BUILDER/prime attribution, not always on-orbit owner. Verified 2026-07-07.
NYSE: BA. Builds 702-series comsats and defense/space systems. BUILDER/prime attribution, not always on-orbit owner. Verified 2026-07-07.
Dual-listed Nasdaq: TSAT and TSX: TSAT. GEO fleet + Lightspeed LEO constellation (first launches slated late 2026). Verified 2026-07-07.
US federal agency -- no public equity. Owner/operator of science & Earth-observation missions (Landsat with USGS, Terra/Aqua, etc.). ticker null by construction.
US federal agency -- no public equity. Owns the GOES + JPSS/NOAA weather-satellite fleets (built by primes like LMT). ticker null by construction.
Intergovernmental agency -- no public equity. Operates/co-operates Copernicus Sentinel EO missions (with the EU) and science missions. ticker null by construction.

US military service -- no public equity. On-orbit owner/operator of GPS (navigation), SBIRS/missile-warning, WGS/AEHF milcomms (sats built by LMT/BA/NOC primes). ticker null by construction; use this to attribute government-owned GPS/defense payloads honestly rather than to a prime's ticker.

operator_name_variants: European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites
operators.notes: Intergovernmental meteorological organisation -- no public equity. Operates Meteosat (MTG) and Metop/EPS weather satellites. ticker null by construction.

US intelligence agency -- no public equity. Owner of classified reconnaissance payloads (often SATCAT-typed as classified/unknown). ticker null by construction; never map a classified payload to a builder's ticker.
